description_en: Modifies the account permissions on a PolarDB for Xscale cluster
description_zh: 修改PolarDB边缘集群的账号权限
kebab_example: aliyun polardb grant-account-privilege-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --account-name testacc --db-name testdb_1,testdb_2 --account-privilege ReadWrite,ReadOnly --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantAccountPrivilegeZonal

parameters.help_en: The name of the database for which to grant permissions. To grant permissions for multiple databases, separate the database names with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要授权的数据库名称。支持同时对一个或多个数据库授权，多个数据库名称之间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The account permissions. Valid values:

ReadWrite: Read and write permissions.

ReadOnly: Read-only permissions.

DMLOnly: DML-only permissions.

DDLOnly: DDL-only permissions.

ReadIndex: Read-only and index permissions
parameters.help_zh:
账号权限，取值范围如下：

ReadWrite：读写
ReadOnly：只读
DMLOnly：只允许 DML
DDLOnly：只允许 DDL
ReadIndex：只读+索引
parameters.name: account_privilege

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
